description: Online event picks to show beside a local search. The Online events band for a local search (a place with a distance, or a state): at most 3 online events anywhere that match the search's words, crafts, types, tags, price and dates, filled from other crafts only when short, each part ranked with a start in the viewer's small hours (10 pm to 7 am in tz) after the rest, then soonest, and the caller's Accept-Language first. Takes the same filters as GET /api/events. `total` and `href` are 'See all online events (N)': /online with the search's top-level crafts and Free only, counted over its next 30 days (the crafts dropped when none has an online event); `matched` is how many picks matched the search's own crafts; `crafts` the search's top-level crafts. Location is never inferred from the caller's IP; a near that matches no US place is a 400.
name: list_online_event_picks
title: Online event picks to show beside a local search
